definitions.full: H7616. shebabim שְׁבָבִים ) noun [masculine] plural probably splinters ; — ׳שׁ שֹׁמְרוֺן עֵגֶל יִהְיֶה Hosea 8:6 (compare We; Vrss appar, conjecture). II. שׁבב (Assyrian šabâbu , blaze , compare Syriac burn , ray, flesh (Lexicons, compare PS); Arabic is blaze up (cf Ba ES 50 ) but = שׁ ? (Another; etymology in Ber Dan 8:22 )).
